## Active

### D-578 — Test runs server groups come from suite config

> _2026-10-18 · realm/blong-test · active_

The test runner used to hardcode the access groups, so a scaffolded realm could not start its own
group. The allowlist is now read from testRealm.testRun.serverGroups, and the dispatch imports every
/\.test$/ group so the runner's proxy can resolve it. The template sets its own group in dev,
integration and test-ui, and seeds testRunServer for Admin.
